svg.aria-label: Two lanes. Lane one: commits 98ac4ced and e7b5051d gave each run its own file and made append create it, so a failed landing's rollback drops that file and the receipt names it; three ids turned green. Lane two: commit 3d02a02f made load read committed run files and order them by completion, so a row is no longer at its append position; one id turned green.
svg.text: Four red ids, and the change that moved the contract each asserts
base ba1a26e4 (four ids failed) · head d9999ede (three test files green, 27 passed) · tests/ only: nothing under reckon/ was modified
THE COMMIT THAT MOVED IT
WHAT THE CODE DOES AT HEAD
ID TURNED GREEN
98ac4ced
each run's row is written to its own file under
the ledger's runs/ directory
append_run creates that file exclusively and
returns its path, not the aggregate ledger's
a failed landing's rollback drops the run file
it wrote, so the appended row leaves the
working tree with it; the receipt names that
file as the rolled-back store and says to
re-promote. A restore git refuses preserves
only a path HEAD already carries, so the
second case seeds the run file into HEAD.
